Content: MemorySmith supports persistent markdown-backed pages stored in Data/Pages as a sibling to Data/Memories and Data/Graph. User-created markdown files under Data/Pages are valid project wiki content and should be committed unless explicitly temporary/private. FilePageService provides list, search, get, save, delete, shared Markdig HTML rendering, page minimum-visibility metadata, and asset saving under Data/Pages/assets. Page visibility is stored in sidecar .page.json metadata with supported values Anonymous, Authenticated (displayed as Signed in), and Admin; pages without metadata use MemorySmith:Pages:DefaultMinimumRole. Page assets are served from /page-assets so markdown image references can be embedded, and assets referenced only by locked pages follow the same visibility gate. Rendered pages use Markdig advanced extensions plus MemorySmith Mermaid/Prism renderers: mermaid fenced code emits pre.mermaid for client-side Mermaid rendering, and other fenced code emits Prism-compatible language-* code classes. The shared client renderer supports Auto/Light/Dark Mermaid theme mode and wraps rendered diagrams in matching readable surfaces so light diagrams work in the dark app shell and dark diagrams remain legible. Raw HTML is disabled by default; trusted local deployments can set MemorySmith:Pages:AllowRawHtml=true when raw HTML media tags are intentionally needed. The /pages UI is separate from memory search and /api/pages exposes page CRUD, search, rendered HTML, and visibility-aware filtering. The editor has a toolbar for common markdown inserts plus an InputFile-backed image upload/embed control that saves assets through SaveAssetAsync and inserts markdown image tags with the returned assets/... path. It also has a visibility selector for users who can change page visibility: editors can choose Anonymous or Authenticated, while admins can also choose Admin. It has toggleable live preview, manual preview refresh, unsaved-change prompts, a fill-height split editor/preview layout, and post-render Mermaid/Prism client-side refresh after preview updates.
